claims.value: 32 channels mapped to 4 groups x 4 replicates (16 samples) plus 16 deuterated duplicates
claims.evidence: experimental_design.tsv lists channel, group and replicate index; pdStudy quan method TMTpro 32plex with 32 channels; paper: two technical replicates using deuterated or non-deuterated labels

claims.value: 1 non-deuterated, 2 deuterated (D_ prefix) with matching index
claims.evidence: paper Data availability sentence; index pairing inferred from names
RAW names end _FrN; paper: 16 high-pH fractions

claims.value: Mus musculus; dorsal root ganglion; male; C57BL/6J; neuropathic pain
claims.evidence: paper TMT MS methods: male SNI C57BL6/J WT mice, ipsilateral/contralateral L3-L5 DRGs

claims.value: AAV8-Di-C5 (GCN4-HWLKV) vs AAV8-tdTomato; ipsi vs contra
claims.evidence: paper Fig 6 legend and MS methods; GCN4/tdT group names from deposit

claims.value: Orbitrap Ascend; DDA; ion trap; CID
claims.evidence: PRIDE instruments field and paper (ion trap MS2, CID activation, HCD MS3); RAW headers not read

claims.location: comment[cleavage agent details], modification parameters, tolerances
claims.value: Trypsin; CAM fixed; Ox M, Phospho STY, TMTpro K/N-term variable; 10 ppm; 0.6 Da
claims.evidence: Sequest HT node parameters in pdStudy

limitations: Deuterated channel D_<group> n assumed to be the same sample as <group> n (paper says technical replicates; pairing by index not explicitly stated).
Biological replicate index is the deposit's per-group index; ipsi n and contra n not stated to be the same mouse.
GCN4 group assumed to be AAV8-Di-C5 and tdT AAV8-tdTomato (paper Fig 6 text).
Labels for 16 deuterated channels were produced via placeholder labels in sdrf-tools build and mapped back by script (build regex does not accept D channels).
Cleavage agent Trypsin chosen though the paper also names Lys-C; reconcile flags it as not in the PRIDE record text.
Dissociation CID only; HCD MS3 quantification not encoded. RAW headers were not read; instrument from PRIDE and paper.

Developmental stage not available (7-12 weeks stated generically); sampling time range, sample type and enrichment process omitted; PRIDE field says non- and deuterated labels while methods say non-deuterated only.
